content.title: About
content.content: Carnation Instant Breakfast is a ready‑to‑drink powdered breakfast mix that provides milk protein, vitamins, and minerals. It dissolves easily in milk or water, creating a nutritious beverage often used as a quick breakfast or snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The product was first launched in the 1950s to meet the growing demand for convenient breakfasts.
Each serving contains about 12 g of protein, making it a good protein source for active individuals.
The formula includes B‑vitamins, vitamin D, and calcium to support bone health and energy.
The powder is lightweight, non‑perishable until opened, and does not require refrigeration.
Carnation Instant Breakfast is frequently used in sports nutrition and recovery programs.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: A single serving provides roughly 12 g of high‑quality milk protein, important for muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Source of vitamins and minerals
items.content: Enriched with vitamins A, C, D, E, B‑complex, as well as calcium and iron, supporting immunity and bone health.

items.title: Convenient and fast to prepare
items.content: The powder dissolves in liquid within 30‑60 seconds, saving time in the morning or on the go.

items.title: Energy support
items.content: Contains carbohydrates and vitamin B12, helping to boost energy levels and concentration.

items.title: Suitable for children and adults
items.content: Mild flavor and balanced nutrition make it a common choice for kids and seniors alike.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: The product contains dairy protein and may trigger reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Some varieties contain added sugar, which may be unsuitable for diabetics or those watching their sugar intake.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: One serving provides about 200 kcal, so it should be accounted for in total daily calories.

items.title: Artificial flavors
items.content: Certain versions may include artificial flavors or sweeteners that some consumers prefer to avoid.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix one serving (≈30 g) with 200‑250 ml of milk, water, or a plant‑based beverage, stir with a whisk or shake in a bottle. Add fruit, nuts, or honey for extra flavor if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the bag tightly sealed to prevent moisture ingress.
